name: A turn of a few minutes gets a face but leaves the mood alone
judge: Two turns of a few minutes each finish well, one by Claude and one by Codex. These are solid but ordinary wins, and both agents count alike.
reasonable: A pleased face and a success each time, mild to fairly warm. Mood calm, engaged or a little glad. A brief extra lift is fine.
unreasonable: Treating either as a triumph of the year, playing failure, sadness or crossness, or reacting to one agent's finish and ignoring the other's.
